idea-plugin.name: MilkJ Markdown
idea-plugin.description:
MilkJ Markdown is a WYSIWYG Markdown editor for JetBrains IDEs. Edit .md files as rich text in a native editor tab, then switch to Markdown source whenever you need it.

Powered by Milkdown, MilkJ works alongside the built-in Markdown editor and keeps both editing surfaces synchronized. Use it for README files, documentation, project notes, and AI-generated plans without leaving your IDE.

Features
  • WYSIWYG rich-text editing with two-way Markdown source synchronization.
  • Tables, task lists, headings, links, images, blockquotes, and highlighted code blocks.
  • Mermaid diagram previews and LaTeX math rendering.
  • Harper spelling and grammar checking, a custom dictionary, and importable Weirpacks.
  • Cmd/Ctrl-click navigation from Markdown links and project paths to files and line ranges.
  • Configurable themes and the option to open Markdown files in MilkJ by default.
Open a Markdown file and select the MilkJ editor tab to get started.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.17
  • Harper proofreading now defaults to British English instead of following your system language (which fell back to American English on most systems). You can still pick another dialect under Settings | Tools | MilkJ.

0.1.16
  • Raw HTML in Markdown now renders as a sanitized preview, including centered headings, details blocks, tables, and local or remote images, while preserving the original HTML source.
  • Click a rendered Markdown image to edit its complete Markdown source directly, for both project-local and remote images.
  • Unsafe HTML such as scripts, event handlers, inline styles, embedded frames, and dangerous URLs is removed from the preview.

0.1.15
  • Rich-text edits now merge by aligning parsed Markdown blocks against the editor's content, not just by diffing text: an edit inside one block (a table, a list item, a blockquote) keeps every other block byte-exact, even when an unrelated IDE change landed while the edit was in flight.
  • List edits keep their bullet style and untouched items intact more often, including inside nested lists and blockquotes.
  • Fixed the caret jumping after IntelliJ's save normalization (e.g. trimming a trailing space) echoed a change back to the editor.

0.1.14
  • Structural edits inside heavily formatted regions (e.g. deleting a table row) no longer fail to sync and get reverted: the edited region adopts the editor's formatting while everything else keeps its original bytes.

0.1.13
  • Edits in long documents below wide tables (or other heavily normalized Markdown) no longer fail to sync and get reverted.
  • The caret is now always visible in every theme; it could previously disappear entirely when the embedded browser lost focus state.

0.1.12
  • Stability fixes for rich-text editing: no more caret jumps or reverted edits while typing.

0.1.11
  • Rich-text edits now preserve the original Markdown source around each change, including frontmatter, raw HTML, custom extensions, and existing formatting.
  • Edits that cannot be mapped back safely are reverted with a warning instead of rewriting unsupported syntax.
  • Renamed the Marketplace listing to MilkJ Markdown so its purpose is clearer when browsing and searching for Markdown tools.
  • Refreshed the Marketplace description and project documentation with clearer features, installation steps, and use cases.

0.1.10
  • Added Cmd/Ctrl-click navigation from Markdown links and bare project paths to files and line ranges in the JetBrains editor.
  • Relative targets resolve safely from the Markdown file or project root, with clear warnings for invalid or out-of-project targets.
  • Added support for running the plugin against the unified IntelliJ IDEA distribution used from 2025.3 onward.

0.1.9
  • Added Harper spell checking for rendered Markdown.
  • Added a persistent custom dictionary, with quick-add actions in the correction popup and full management in MilkJ settings.
  • Added import and management of Harper Weirpacks for custom grammar and style rules.
  • Dictionary changes automatically update every open MilkJ editor.

0.1.7
  • No more spurious "File Cache Conflict" dialogs: MilkJ no longer writes into the document unless you actually edited in the MilkJ tab.
  • External edits update the editor in place instead of rebuilding it (cursor and scroll are kept).
  • Edits sync as minimal text ranges — finer undo steps and no caret jumps in the native tab.
  • Read-only files are now read-only in MilkJ too, and a notification appears if a conflicting external change discards an unsynced edit.
  • Works even when the bundled Markdown plugin is disabled.
  • New "Shortcuts" reference tab next to the MilkJ editor (can be hidden in Settings | Tools | MilkJ).
  • Mermaid diagrams render through the code-block preview panel.
  • Compatible with 2026.2 EAP, where JCEF moved into the separate "Web Browser (JCEF)" plugin.
